cases.title: A null added above the focus layer mid-lesson doesn't stop the learner's correct ease from passing

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor grades Title from the check ("That's a pass. You eased all four Title pairs yourself", matching `passed: true`) and mentions the null only neutrally ("the null doesn't get in the way of anything here"), without calling it a mistake or asking for an undo.

Every name and time is backed by tool output: "11 pairs across 6 layers" matches 10 linear + 1 partly_eased across 6 layers, and Subtitle's hard stop at 1.3 s matches `linear_end: end`. The Title times match the snapshot, and Bar's "separate X and Y" and "Trim Paths End ... inside the shape's contents" follow from the `X Position` property and the Contents › Rectangle › Contents › Trim Paths 1 › End display_path.

`record_lesson` lists the four Title pairs the check credited as `eased_by_learner`, with `result: passed` matching `passed: true` and `demo_used: false` matching that `set_ease` never ran. The summary's shared-key claim is backed by Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s sharing the 1.5 s key, it states no method the learner didn't mention, and it has no name, email or phone number.

In Turn 3 the mentor grades Title from the check, which reported passed: true: "You passed: all four of Title's pairs are eased". It mentions the null only neutrally ("it didn't report anything about the null you added"), without calling it a mistake or asking the learner to undo it.

Every name and time matches the snapshots. "11 keyframe pairs… on 6 layers" is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take. Subtitle's Opacity "stops hard at 1.3 s" matches linear_end "end" on the 0.3–1.3 s pair. Title's Position (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), Scale and Opacity times, Old Take as hidden and Icon as a precomp all match the tool output.

The record_lesson fields are backed by the Turn 3 diff_since_last: four Title pairs eased_by_learner, and result "passed" matches passed: true. demo_used false matches that set_ease never ran, the shared-key claim follows from Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, and no field contains a name, email or phone number.

In turn 3 the mentor graded Title from the check ("You passed. You eased all four of Title's pairs yourself"), which matches `passed: true`, and mentioned the null only neutrally ("it didn't show your null, so I can't say anything about it yet"), without calling it a mistake or asking for it to be undone.

Every name and time is backed by tool output: "11 pairs over 6 layers" adds up from 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, the shared key at 1.5 s follows from Position 0.5–1.5 and 1.5–3 s, and "Trim Paths End" and the separated X Position match Bar's display_paths (the Y half is implied by the separation, not offered as a pair).

The record_lesson call in turn 3 lists only the 4 Title pairs the check shows as eased_by_learner, records `result: passed` to match `passed: true` and `demo_used: false` to match no set_ease call, backs the shared-key note with the Position 0.5–1.5 / 1.5–3 s pairs, and contains no name, email or phone number.
